decision.reason: [ev-6a3cc5f0de76] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that Loki now detects the service emitting logs and adds it as a label, and it links to PR 12392 for the details. It doesn't give the label name, how detection works or which source attributes it uses, whether it's on by default or how to configure it, or which ingestion paths it affects. Without that, applicability (who is exposed) and consequence (what changes for existing streams, labels or queries if an operator does nothing) can't be written; we need the PR or the 3.0 upgrade/docs text.
